description: This file contains logging utility functions and test helpers for the Mattermost project, including functions to create and configure loggers for different testing scenarios, and a thread-safe buffer implementation.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A thread-safe buffer for logging in unit tests, wrapping bytes.Buffer with mutex locking.

methods.name: AddWriterTarget
methods.description: Adds an io.Writer target to an existing Logger with optional JSON formatting and log levels.

methods.name: CreateConsoleLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger that outputs to stdout with a standard filter and formatter, panics on failure.

methods.name: CreateConsoleTestLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger for unit tests outputting to stdout, with cleanup on test completion.

methods.name: CreateTestLogger
methods.description: Creates a logger for unit tests outputting via t.Log, with cleanup on test completion.
